ui_bugs.issue: Spacing fix regression — the three bottom cards are NOT equal width as required by the review spec. Measured on tablet 1194x834: before-you-ride=244.8px, fb50=210.8px, mpc=210.8px (max_diff=34px). Same 34px delta on phone-landscape 844x390. Root cause: PreRideCard renders `<LinearGradient style={styles.bottomCard}>` directly (bottomCard has flex:1) as a child of `styles.bottomRow`, while FB50/MPC wrap their LinearGradient inside a `<Touchable style={{flex:1}} containerStyle={{flex:1}}>`. On react-native-web, Pressable renders with `flex-basis: auto` by default, so the two Touchable-wrapped cards end up with a smaller effective flex basis than the direct LinearGradient. Fix: either (a) wrap PreRideCard in a `<View style={{flex:1}}>` matching the Touchable-wrapper shape (or vice-versa), or (b) apply an explicit `flexBasis: 0, minWidth: 0` on each of the three bottom cards to force equal distribution, or (c) apply `flex: 1, flexBasis: 0` via a shared style used by all three. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/training.tsx:301-321 (PreRideCard), :324-343 (FB50), :364-377 (MPC); /app/frontend/src/components/training.tsx:442 (bottomCard) and /app/frontend/app/training.tsx:203 (bottomRow).

action_items: PRIMARY: Fix equal-width for the three bottom cards on '/training' (before-you-ride-card, fb50-card, mpc-card). Recommended fix: add `flexBasis: 0, minWidth: 0` to `styles.bottomCard` in /app/frontend/src/components/training.tsx (currently only has `flex: 1`). critical_code_review_comments: styles.bottomCard uses only `flex: 1` without `flexBasis: 0` — on react-native-web with a mix of Pressable-wrapped and direct-LinearGradient children, this collapses to content-driven sizing, hence the ~34px width delta.

Touchable in ui.tsx: containerStyle goes on Pressable, style goes on inner Animated.View. Callers pass `style={{flex:1}} containerStyle={{flex:1}}` for fb50/mpc — but PreRideCard has no such wrapper. Consider unifying all three bottom cards behind a single wrapper (e.g. a `<BottomCardSlot>` view) so future spacing changes only touch one file.

rca_of_issue: BOTTOM-ROW EQUAL-WIDTH — Reproduction: open /training at 1194x834, scroll training-scroll to y=2000, measure the 3 bottom cards' widths; before-you-ride is 244.8px vs fb50/mpc at 210.8px. Root cause: `styles.bottomCard` uses `{ flex: 1 }` without `flexBasis: 0`. React-native-web maps `flex:1` to `flex:1 1 auto` (auto basis) so children distribute width based on min-content in addition to the flex grow factor. PreRideCard is a direct `<LinearGradient>` child with flex:1; FB50/MPC are `<Pressable(Touchable)>` wrapping an inner `<Animated.View>` wrapping a `<LinearGradient>` — the extra wrapper levels do not carry the same intrinsic min-content, so they end up narrower. Mitigation: add `flexBasis: 0` (and `minWidth: 0`) to `styles.bottomCard` AND to the Touchable containerStyle on fb50/mpc; alternatively wrap PreRideCard in `<View style={{flex:1, flexBasis:0, minWidth:0}}>` to match the Touchable wrapper. Verified by inspection of /app/frontend/src/components/training.tsx:301-321,324-343,364-377,442 and /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx:40-55.
